## OP-20 disclosures  

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline  
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size: 342 trading days (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Selection method: all trading days in the period. Overfit risk: medium (strategy uses opening range, VWAP, pullback, and ribbon confirmation parameters; grinder tested multiple parameter combinations).  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not performed in Stage-1; requires Stage-2)  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not validated with real OPRA fills; requires Stage-2 real-fills check)  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: 2025-08-12 (-$410)  
   - Max drawdown: -$1,850  
   - Blow-up scenario: Extended low-volatility regime (VIX < 12) causes repeated false pullback signals, leading to consecutive losses.  
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 38% of P&L (days: 5/04, 4/29, 5/01, 2025-11-03, 2026-03-15)
